svg.aria-label: Medicare Supplement enrollment IDP pipeline: a document lands in S3, EventBridge starts a Step Functions state machine that runs a lightweight OCR pass to classify the document against a configured set of form fingerprints, runs the classified variant's Textract FORMS/QUERIES analysis, validates and stores a canonical record in DynamoDB, transforms it to XML, and submits it to a mock or real Enrollment API, with any step failure routed to a dead-letter queue.
svg.title: Medicare Supplement Enrollment IDP Pipeline — Architecture
svg.text: S3 upload → EventBridge → Step Functions → classify (config match) → Textract → canonical record → XML → Enrollment API

g.text: via CLI or the web app — see webapp-architecture.svg

svg.text: Every task below retries on transient errors and Catches to the DLQ (arrow omitted per-task for clarity)

g.text: Lambda · builds query set for variant
